definitions.explanation: Edible nuts such as almonds, cashews, walnuts, and peanuts. Used as a general category term for tree nuts and similar snack foods.

examples.japanese: ミックスナッツ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
ナッツ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{栄養|えいよう}→栄養：01882_eiyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{豊富|ほうふ}→豊富：03620_houfu⟧で⟦おやつ→おやつ：17921_oyatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ぴったり→ぴったり：02362_pittari⟧だ。
examples.english: Nuts are rich in nutrients and perfect as a snack.

examples.japanese: ナッツ⟦アレルギー→アレルギー：04645_arerugii⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{原材料|げんざいりょう}→原材料：18966_genzairyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{必|かなら}ず→必ず：01249_kanarazu⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}している→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: I have a nut allergy, so I always check the ingredients.

notes:
USAGE:
ナッツ is the standard loanword for nuts as a food category. Individual nut types also use loanwords: ⟦アーモンド→アーモンド：10714_aamondo⟧ (almond), カシューナッツ (cashew), マカダミアナッツ (macadamia), ピーナッツ (peanut). The native word ⟦{木|き}の{実|み}→木の実：13018_kinomi⟧ also means nuts/tree nuts but has a broader meaning that includes acorns and other non-edible seeds.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ミックスナッツ: mixed nuts
- ナッツ⟦アレルギー→アレルギー：04645_arerugii⟧: nut allergy
- ナッツ⟦{類|るい}→類：15121_rui⟧: nut varieties
- ⟦{素焼|すや}き→素焼き：24657_suyaki⟧ナッツ: plain roasted nuts (unsalted, no oil)
